name: automation-scripts
description: Shell automation scripts for macOS using zsh

scripts.lint: zsh -f -c 'for script in **/*.sh; do IFS= read -r shebang < "$script"; case "$shebang" in "#!/usr/bin/env zsh") zsh -f -n "$script" ;; "#!/usr/bin/env bash"|"#!/bin/bash") bash -n "$script" ;; *) print -u2 "Unsupported shell shebang: $script"; exit 1 ;; esac || exit; done'
scripts.test:3d: zsh tests/test-organize-3d-imports.sh && zsh tests/test-3d-import-jobs.sh && zsh tests/test-3d-print-catalog.sh

author: Brandon Martinez
